Name: Sebastian Into Victor Nikiforov
Author: ZentheguineapigNerd
Description:
This turns Sebastian into Victor Nikiforov. there is still a ton to be done but I am doing my best will update when I can!



To Download:
1. Install the latest version of SMAPI
2. Install this mod from Nexus mods
3. Unzip any Content Patcher content packs into Mods to install them
4. Run the game using SMAPI
5. Enjoy!


I WILL be updating

Things to Expect in next update!

Cleaner sprites and portrait!
More Dialogue such as gift tastes and marriage dialogue
The name under portrait to be changed to Victor
